answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose identity commitment is anchored to a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree and network beacon. RLN proofs enforce each agent’s messaging quota without exposing its identity; however, duplicate messaging yields distinct Shamir shares of the same secret, allowing interpolation to reveal the registered private key and trigger instantaneous, publicly verifiable collateral slashing. The pearl and jade tags identify commitments, not users.
